newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, deposits mainly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, deposits mainly unchanged.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly unchanged in quiet trade amid high liquidity in the market, dealers said.
They said trade focused on the short dates. Spot-next was put at 5-1/4, 1/8 percent. One-week was at 5-5/16, 3/16 percent.
"The market is still very liquid. There are many buyers of U.S. dollars from Bahrain," one Riyadh-based dealer said.
The spot riyal was quoted at 3.7505/06 to the dollar.
One-month rates fell 1/16 point to 5-1/2, 3/8 percent. Three months were steady at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, six months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and one-year were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent.
